seoTitle: Manage My Booking — Manchester River Cruises
seoDescription: Manage your Manchester River Cruises booking online — reschedule, choose a date for an open ticket, cancel where eligible or view your tickets. You'll need your booking reference and email.
heading: Manage my booking

sections.heading: Things to call us about
body: Some changes are quicker with a human. Get in touch for any of these and we’ll sort it.

sections.heading: Can’t find your booking?
body: If your reference isn’t recognised, check it against your confirmation email — then our team is happy to help.

items: Reschedule your cruise — change the date or the time.
Pick a date for an open (undated) ticket.
Cancel your booking where it’s still eligible.
View your tickets once payment has gone through.

cards.name: Weather cancellations
cards.desc: Cruises run in most weather — the boat has a heated indoor cabin. If we ever have to cancel for conditions on the water, we’ll contact you directly; call us if you’re unsure before you travel. (TBC)

cards.name: Group & large-party changes
cards.desc: Changes to group bookings and larger parties are handled by our team so we can keep seating and boarding right for everyone. (TBC)

cards.name: Cancellations & refunds
cards.desc: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before departure. For anything inside that window, or if you’re not sure what your booking allows, give us a call. (Full policy TBC.)
